cases.purpose: pcap -i selects the interface: only frames seen on it are written; nonexistent interface fails.
cases.oracle: Two veth pairs in a fresh mapped user+network namespace (IPv6 disabled so only injected frames exist). Frames are injected with AF_PACKET on one veth end; the candidate captures on the peer end. Expected pcap content is derived from the injected bytes and decoded independently with struct and tcpdump -r; netids blocking uses a recording fw executable first in PATH. Per-check detail in stderr of the raw record.
cases.comparison: Contract: candidate-only run; per-check detail retained in stderr of the raw record, stdout carries the verdict.
